content: म्रक्ष् I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (म्रक्षति) .²1 To rub; मृक्षा शीर्षा चतुर्णाम् <ls>Rv. 8. 74. 13</ls>. .²2 To heap, collect, accumulate. .²3 To strike, hurt, kill. --II. €10 <ab>U.</ab> (म्रक्षयति-ते) .²1 To heap, accumulate. .²2 To smear, rub, anoint. .²3 To mix, combine. .²4 To speak indistinctly.
